Name: Legacy Coops and Barns
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXCf8B4M/coops-and-barns.png[/img][/center][center]⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐[/center]
[center]
Bigger and more spaciously laid out coops and barns for our animals! Also with an additional lower area to hold plenty of machines or storage if needed, so that you don't have to use extra sheds or have them outside, if you don't want to.
The animals can't access the lower areas, only you! 

I have also uploaded an optional version without the additional, lower room in the Deluxe Coop and Deluxe Barn.
Just in case you'd prefer only the main coop and barn areas!

I hope you enjoy them![/center][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/65sPtdSf/my-other-mods.png[/img][/center][center][youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center][center]﻿[/center]
I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
